# Supplied police car

Extracted directly from Koda's `police car 3d model.zip` on October 20, 2026. The FBX and JPEG bytes are unchanged. No decimation, planar conversion, remeshing, vertex editing or nonuniform scaling is applied.

FBX SHA-256: `BEF2445C622AC69BAFB734D90BE5F7173EC9046F03790B48DD18D6761CE1445A`.

Unity uses the imported FBX mesh directly with its supplied base-colour image. A uniform instance scale fits a 4.6 m car; instance rotations align its nose and park it along the road. A separate box provides collision. `PresentationPolish.ParkCar` owns this placement. The previous car pack is retained for history.
